prompt_cohort.relationship_to_gate_a: No exact prompt overlap with the 48 clean calibration trajectories used by Gate A.

measurement.anchor_signal: z_c = ||Taylor(v_a,v_b;c)-v_c|| / ||v_c|| at each actual anchor c followed by skips
measurement.skipped_step_truth: At each natural skip, run shadow full-DiT on the identical pre-step cache latent and record relative L2; advance the original cached prediction.
measurement.segment_damage: sum_t |delta_sigma_t| ||vhat_t-v_t_shadow|| / sum_t |delta_sigma_t| ||v_t_shadow|| between c and the next actual anchor d
measurement.phase_control: Compute association within each fixed c-to-d segment across prompts before aggregating segments.

primary.estimand: Equal-weight mean of within-fixed-segment Spearman correlations.

interpretation.pass: Only authorize a disjoint fit/holdout conditional-upper-bound study.
interpretation.fail: Do not use anchor Gram measurements to control future skip budgets for this predictor and schedule.
